title: USDA NASS Crop Production Record
description: Schema for USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS) QuickStats crop production data, covering planted/harvested area, yield, production, and price statistics at national, state, and county levels.

record_id.description: Unique identifier for the record (UUID v4)

state_name.description: Full state name corresponding to state_fips

county_fips.description: Five-digit county FIPS code (state + county digits)

statisticcat_desc.description: Statistical category describing what is being measured

unit_desc.description: Unit of measure for the reported value

value.description: The statistical value for the given commodity, category, and unit

cv_percent.description: Coefficient of variation expressed as a percentage; null when not applicable or suppressed

source_desc.description: Source of the data: sample survey or decennial census

agg_level_desc.description: Geographic aggregation level of the record

domain_desc.description: Domain classification for the record (e.g. chemical applied, irrigation practice)

reference_period_desc.description: Time period the value references, such as YEAR, MAR, or MARKETING YEAR

load_time.description: Timestamp when the record was loaded from the NASS API

_ingested_at.description: Timestamp when the record was ingested into the Fabric lakehouse

_batch_id.description: Batch run identifier for lineage and reprocessing traceability
